title: Page 5
content_zh:
深秋的兰凌王宫，原本苍翠的绿树逐渐染上黄、褐色泽，池中的荷叶也尽数枯萎，秋风吹来，瑟瑟作响，增添了不少苍凉之气。
入夜之后，各殿的灯火接连亮起，一名身穿猎装的男子走在长廊上，前后都有宫女提灯引路，一路走进早已点起灯火的华丽寝殿。
这里是「龙翔殿」，历代兰凌王的居处。
「王。」殿里的宫女们看到他回来，赶紧躬身行礼，态度谨慎小心。
十年过去，二十五岁的兰霆早已摆脱过去消瘦的模样，高而挺拔的身子穿起猎装英气逼人，虽然样貌俊秀斯文，但他只要板起脸，锐利的眼神足以震慑人心。
而经过这些年来的历练，他的脾气也不再像少年时那样冲动易怒，变得沉稳许多，但那不怒而威的王者气势，教人心生臣服。
兰霆进到寝殿里，没有多瞧宫女一眼，冷声命令。「将本王的猎装换下。」
「是。」宫女们开始帮兰霆小心脱下猎装，接着帮他换上平时惯穿的常服。
待兰霆换完衣裳后，一旁的宫女拿来温水盆及布巾，让他擦脸净手。
等到一切都打理完之后，宫女恭谨地询问：「王，奴婢是否要吩咐膳房帮王备膳？」王才刚从猎场回来，应该还没用过膳才是。
他没回答宫女的问题，倒是先问：「雪莹用膳了没？」
「宗姑娘今日推说胃口不好，所以……吃得很少，早早便睡了。」宫女谨慎小心地回答，就怕他气恼。
吃得很少？恐怕宫女回答得含蓄了些，她根本就是没吃吧！兰霆的眉一蹙，没好气地大步离开寝殿，命令道：「去备两份膳来，越快越好。」
「是。」
兰霆走出龙翔殿，殿旁有一道穿廊，连接着旁边另一座较典雅的小寝殿「暖芳阁」，两殿靠得非常近，因此兰霆很快便进到暖芳阁里。
暖芳阁是他为宗雪莹打造的殿阁，紧邻在他的龙翔殿旁，只要他想，他可以随时过来看她，随时掌握她的情况。
丫鬟朵儿看到兰霆出现，正要领着其他宫女向他问安，但她都还来不及开口，兰霆的长袖一挥，制止她们出声，朵儿也非常识相地和宫女退到一旁去。
他一进到内房，内房里暖呼呼的，虽然现在才入秋，但内房里却已燃起一座暖炉，就怕住在这里的人儿不小心受凉了。
他无声地来到床边，掀开垂下的纱帐，就见宗雪莹舒服地侧躺在大床中央，雪白的毛毯将她完全遮盖住，只露出一张小脸蛋，黑而柔的长发披散在身侧，看起来慵懒中又带有一丝娇媚。
他坐在床旁，原本冷淡的眸色慢慢多了一抹柔情，就连冷硬的嘴角也微勾起淡笑，静静地瞧着她的睡颜。

经过十年的照顾，她也从小丫头转变成十八岁的小姑娘，出落得美丽动人，虽然她的脸色总是显得苍白，只有额心那一抹红印始终鲜红，但这娇弱的气质，更是我见犹怜，任谁见了，都想好好地怜惜她一番。
他伸出手，轻抚着她柔嫩的脸蛋，怎么摸都摸不腻，像是在把玩着自己珍爱的宝物，一遍又一遍，舍不得歇手。
原来照顾人是会上瘾的，他已经习惯每日都会见到她，看她总是灿烂的笑容，偶尔和她吵吵嘴，享受着她对他的率真回应。
在这座王宫里，只有她不把他当王看待，不战战兢兢的面对他，和她在一起，他可以放松下心情，不把自己当成王，暂时喘一口气。
刚睡下不久的宗雪莹被脸上的刻意骚扰慢慢赶去睡意，逐渐苏醒过来，她嘤咛了一声，睁开双眼，看到坐在床边的男人便漾起灿烂的笑。
「没想到王也会趁我睡着时欺负我，要是说出去，肯定没人相信。」他一出现，她的睡意尽消，慵懒地坐起身，故意揶揄他。
「本王哪里欺负你了？」他挑了挑眉，一点都不觉得刚才在她脸上的「骚扰」是欺负。
「故意把我吵醒，难道不是欺负？」宗雪莹轻笑出声。「真该让其他人看看，平常总是大摆冷脸的王，居然也有如此孩子气的一面。」
她知道，只有在她面前时，他才会显露出这一面，不像高高在上的王，反而像是一个疼宠妹妹的普通男人，与她之间没有任何尊卑之分。
「不会有其他人瞧见的，你还是死了那条心吧。」他瞪了她一眼，警告她别打任何歪主意。
「真霸道的口气。」她故意噘起嘴抱怨，但听起来倒比较像在撒娇。
「敢说本王霸道？」兰霆瞬间摆起冷脸，作势要朝她的脸蛋捏过去。「你这个大胆的丫头……」
「啊……我认错，请王别捏我，我的脸蛋可没什么肉好捏呀……」宗雪莹赶紧左躲右闪，胸前的衣襟因为躲避的动作不经意敞开，露出里头淡粉色的绣花肚兜，若隐若现。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
他本以为自己会一直将她当妹妹看待，但在她渐渐长大，脱掉稚气，开始有了小女人般的娇柔后，他内心有一处情感也开始骚动起来，看她的眼光不再单纯，也无法再继续把她当成妹妹看待。
他逐渐意识到，她终究和他没有任何血缘关系，她已经到了青春娇艳的年纪，足以吸引任何男人的目光……
当然也包括他的。
为了转移自己的注意力，他故意挑起其他话题。「不是想听本王去秋猎所发生的事情，怎么这么快就睡了？」
「我累了嘛。」她任由兰霆帮她整理衣襟，早已习惯两人偶有亲密之举，故意娇声抱怨道：「我最讨厌只能待在房里等待，什么事都不能做，倒不如就先睡了。」
她多想跟着他一起去秋猎，但是他不允，害她只能无趣地待在房里，心里郁闷着，连晚膳也不用就睡了。

「就算如此，你也不该任性不用膳，存心折磨自己的身子和本王作对。」她的心思他就算没有全摸透，也有七、八成，她肯定是故意不用晚膳，好气他不让她跟着去秋猎。
宗雪莹的表情一僵，有些心虚地说：「反正……我就是没胃口……」
此时宫女们恰恰好将两人的晚膳端进，将桌椅一并摆进来，很快地便摆好膳食，食物的香气顿时弥漫在房里，也像是在告诉宗雪莹——她这下子想不吃也不行了。
「来得正好。」有其他宫女在场，兰霆马上摆起脸孔，起身离开床榻，不容她拒绝地命令道：「下床，陪本王用膳。」
她没好气地嘟起嘴，真不喜欢被命令的感觉，因为那就表示事情没得转圜，她只能乖乖听话。
兰霆见宗雪莹依旧坐在床上，迟迟没有下床的动作，就知道她故意在和他闹别扭。
这座王宫里谁敢和他闹别扭？也只有这个大胆的丫头，谁教她是他心头上抛不下的一个牵挂，才会将她的脾气养娇了，一点都不怕他。
「雪莹，快过来。」他只好放软姿态，朝她伸出手，就连语气也柔和不少。「再不过来，就别怪本王罚你了。」
虽然他还是不改威胁的话语，但她听得出他软化的语气，才又恢复笑颜，伸手让他宽而暖的大掌牢牢握住，不再和他使性子。
她知道，他是王，是高高在上的，不容任何人忤逆，但他却允许她偶尔耍赖、无礼、使性子，他对她的包容，是给她的补偿，她从一开始就非常清楚这一点。
就算明知他对她的好只是补偿，但她的心，还是慢慢地陷入，对他出现了不该有的倾慕，希望能得到他更多的注意、疼宠，成为他心目中的唯一。
content_en:
In the Lanling Palace in late autumn, the originally lush green trees gradually turned yellow and brown, and the lotus leaves in the pond were all withered. The autumn wind blew and rustled, adding a lot of desolation.
After nightfall, the lights in each palace were turned on one after another. A man in a hunting suit walked on the corridor, with maids holding lanterns in front and behind leading the way, and walked into the gorgeous dormitory that had already been lit.
This is the "Longxiang Hall", the residence of King Lanling in the past dynasties.
「王。」殿里的宫女们看到他回来，赶紧躬身行礼，态度谨慎小心。
十年过去，二十五岁的兰霆早已摆脱过去消瘦的模样，高而挺拔的身子穿起猎装英气逼人，虽然样貌俊秀斯文，但他只要板起脸，锐利的眼神足以震慑人心。
而经过这些年来的历练，他的脾气也不再像少年时那样冲动易怒，变得沉稳许多，但那不怒而威的王者气势，教人心生臣服。
兰霆进到寝殿里，没有多瞧宫女一眼，冷声命令。 "Change out of my hunting attire."
「是。」宫女们开始帮兰霆小心脱下猎装，接着帮他换上平时惯穿的常服。
After Lan Ting finished changing his clothes, the maid on the side brought him a basin of warm water and a cloth to wipe his face and hands.
After everything was taken care of, the palace maid asked respectfully: "King, do you want me to ask the kitchen to prepare meals for the king?" The king had just returned from the hunting ground, so he probably hadn't eaten yet.
他没回答宫女的问题，倒是先问：「雪莹用膳了没？」
"Miss Zong said she had a bad appetite today, so... she ate very little and went to bed early." The palace maid answered cautiously, fearing that he would be angry.
Eating very little? I'm afraid the palace maid's answer was a bit reserved. She simply didn't eat! Lan Ting frowned, strode out of the dormitory angrily, and ordered: "Go prepare two meals, the sooner the better."
"Yes."
Lan Ting walked out of the Longxiang Hall. There was a corridor next to the hall, which connected another more elegant small sleeping hall "Nuanfang Pavilion" next to it. The two halls were very close to each other, so Lan Ting quickly entered the Nuanfang Pavilion.
Nuanfang Pavilion is the palace he built for Zong Xueying. It is right next to his Longxiang Palace. As long as he wants, he can come over to see her at any time and understand her situation at any time.
When the maid Duo'er saw Lan Ting appear, she was about to lead the other maids to greet him, but before she could speak, Lan Ting waved her long sleeves to stop them from speaking, and Duo'er also stepped aside with the maids very wisely.
As soon as he entered the inner room, it was warm. Although it was only autumn, a stove was already lit in the inner room, fearing that the people living here would accidentally catch a cold.
他无声地来到床边，掀开垂下的纱帐，就见宗雪莹舒服地侧躺在大床中央，雪白的毛毯将她完全遮盖住，只露出一张小脸蛋，黑而柔的长发披散在身侧，看起来慵懒中又带有一丝娇媚。
He sat next to the bed, his originally cold eyes gradually gained a touch of tenderness, and even the corners of his cold lips curled up into a slight smile, quietly looking at her sleeping face.
After ten years of care, she has transformed from a little girl to an eighteen-year-old girl. She is very beautiful. Although her face is always pale and only the red mark on her forehead is always bright red, her delicate temperament makes me feel pity for her. Anyone who sees her wants to take pity on her.
He stretched out his hand and caressed her soft face. No matter how he touched it, he never got tired of it, as if he was playing with his cherished treasure, over and over again, reluctant to stop.
It turns out that taking care of people is addictive. He has become accustomed to seeing her every day, seeing her bright smile, occasionally quarreling with her, and enjoying her frank response to him.
In this palace, she was the only one who didn't treat him like a king and didn't face him with fear. With her, he could relax, not treat himself as a king, and take a breath for a while.Zong Xueying, who had just fallen asleep, was slowly driven away from sleep by the deliberate harassment on her face, and gradually woke up. She let out a sigh, opened her eyes, and smiled brightly when she saw the man sitting beside the bed.
"I didn't expect that the king would bully me while I was asleep. If I told him, no one would believe me." As soon as he appeared, her sleepiness disappeared, and she sat up lazily, teasing him deliberately.
"How did I bully you?" He raised his eyebrows, not feeling that the "harassment" on her face just now was bullying at all.
"Wake me up on purpose, isn't that bullying?" Zong Xueying chuckled. "Others should really see that the king, who usually has a cold face, actually has such a childish side."
She knew that he would only show this side when he was in front of her. He was not like a lofty king, but like an ordinary man who loved his sister, and there was no distinction between him and her.
"No one else will see it. You'd better give up." He glared at her and warned her not to make any crooked ideas.
"What a domineering tone." She complained with a deliberate pout, but it sounded more like she was being coquettish.
"Dare you say that I am overbearing?" Lan Ting instantly put on a cold face and pretended to pinch her face. "You brave girl..."
"Ah... I admit my mistake. Please don't pinch me. I don't have much flesh on my face..." Zong Xueying hurriedly dodged left and right. The placket on her chest was inadvertently opened due to the evasive movement, revealing the light pink embroidered bellyband inside, looming.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
He originally thought that he would always treat her as his sister, but as she gradually grew up, lost her childishness, and began to be as delicate as a little woman, an emotion began to stir in his heart. He no longer looked at her innocently, and he could no longer treat her as his sister.
He gradually realized that she had no blood relationship with him after all. She had reached the age of youth and beauty, enough to attract the attention of any man...
Including his, of course.
In order to divert his attention, he deliberately stirred up other topics. "I didn't want to hear what happened when I went hunting in autumn. Why did you fall asleep so quickly?"
"I'm tired." She allowed Lan Ting to help her adjust her clothes. She was used to the occasional intimacy between the two of them, and deliberately complained softly: "I hate having to stay in the room and wait without being able to do anything. I might as well go to bed first."
She wanted to go hunting in autumn with him, but he refused, so she could only stay in the room boredly, feeling depressed, and went to bed without even having dinner.
"Even so, you shouldn't skip meals willfully, deliberately torture your body and go against me." Even if he didn't fully understand her thoughts, he was probably 70-80% sure that she skipped dinner on purpose and was so angry with him that he wouldn't let her go hunting in the autumn.
Zong Xueying's expression froze, and she said with a guilty conscience: "Anyway... I just have no appetite..."
At this time, the maids just brought in the dinner for the two of them, put the tables and chairs together, and quickly set up the meal. The aroma of the food suddenly filled the room, as if telling Zong Xueying that she couldn't stop eating now.
"You're here just in time." With other maids present, Lan Ting immediately put on a face, got up and left the bed, and ordered without allowing her to refuse: "Get out of bed and have dinner with me."
She pouted angrily. She really didn't like the feeling of being ordered, because it meant that things couldn't change and she could only obey.
Lan Ting saw that Zong Xueying was still sitting on the bed and had not made any move to get out of bed, so he knew that she was deliberately trying to make trouble with him.
Who in this palace dares to quarrel with him? Only this bold girl, who taught her that she was a concern that he could not let go of, could coddle her temper and not be afraid of him at all.
"Xueying, come here quickly." He had no choice but to soften his posture and stretched out his hand towards her. Even his tone was not gentle.few. "If you don't come here, don't blame me for punishing you."
Although he still didn't change his threatening words, she could hear his softened tone, and then she smiled again, stretched out her hand and held it firmly in his wide and warm palm, and stopped trying to get angry with him.
She knew that he was the king, aloof and did not tolerate disobedience from anyone, but he allowed her to occasionally be dishonest, rude, and temperamental. His tolerance for her was compensation for her, and she knew this very well from the beginning.
Even though she knew that his kindness to her was just compensation, her heart slowly fell into her, and she began to have undue admiration for him, hoping to get more attention and love from him and become the only one in his heart.
